statement: A model owner is accountable for model use and performance and for ensuring development, implementation, validation, approval, inventory, and supporting information are maintained within the governance framework.
title: Model owner accountability

statement: Model risk management is an enterprise governance and control framework covering development, implementation, use, validation, oversight, policies, procedures, compliance, and organisational accountability.
title: Model risk governance framework

statement: Model validation assesses performance against design objectives and intended business use, surfaces limitations and assumptions, and requires competent challenge with an appropriate degree of independence.
title: Independent model validation
